description: ERIES publishes synchronised facade pressure and approach-flow measurements for a portal-framed building model. The campaign studies flow acceleration and changes in vertical wind angle. Its stated purpose is to improve quantification of wind loading from extreme non-synoptic events. The release includes time-series measurements and descriptive reports. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: CSV, XLSX, PDF and JPEG images. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The source specifies no fixed geometric scaling and requires appropriate turbulence scaling before application. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
